body:
Hoover wrote:

"Does Bill Gates know he is the anti-christ? And who dares tell him?"

If you have something that you think he needs to hear, here is his page at
Microsoft:

http://www.microsoft.com/billgates/

which links to a form for sending e-mail. 

Or you could just write to:

askbill@microsoft.com

He may not respond if you tell him he's Satan:-)

That's more than I can say about Steve Case at AOL!

I don't think Bill Gates is the anti-Christ. Whoever invented the clock was!
Your time hasn't been your own ever since. Interestingly enough, our fixation
with time *may* lead to a time of troubles for modern civilization, via Y2K.

-Susan
